title: EchoNext: detecting structural heart disease from ECGs with AI
summary: EchoNext was trained on more than 1 million paired heart-rhythm and imaging records from a large health system and outperformed cardiologists in a controlled evaluation. In a prospective clinical trial of patients without prior cardiac imaging, it identified previously undiagnosed heart disease. Exact performance figures were not verified in this search, and model weights and an annotated dataset were released publicly.

evidence.tested: Trained on over 1 million rhythm and imaging records; high accuracy in internal and external validation; outperformed cardiologists in a controlled evaluation; prospectively evaluated in a clinical trial of patients without previous cardiac imaging, identifying undiagnosed disease.
evidence.unknown: Effect on outcomes or costs of screening is not reported in the abstract.
evidence.ai_role: EchoNext, a deep learning model reading electrocardiograms; weights and an annotated dataset were released.
